senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Shush or Sh’vash (prob. the modern Sus = Shushan, v. Sm. Gr. a. Rom. Geogr. s. v. Susa).
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 94a:15">Snh. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מטי שׁוֹש אמרי שׁוֹיא לארעין</he> Rashi (ed. <he>כי ארעין</he>) when they (the Jewish exiles) came to Sh., they said, this is as good as our land.
